entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance purposes. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I hope you can help. I need to return my new VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so disappointed, it's not what I expected at all and I really needed this to work out.

I'm certainly sorry to hear that it's not meeting your expectations. I can look into the return options for you. First, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... I feel bad saying it, but I think I made a mistake. I really need the money back for a bill. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I tried to do the return online yesterday, but the whole system must have been down.
I see. And I do apologize for the trouble with the website. We were experiencing some technical difficulties yesterday. So it was a website error that prevented you from starting the return?
Yes, exactly. I kept getting an error page. I even took a screenshot because I was worried. I just couldn't print a return label or get anything to go through. It was so frustrating.

I completely understand, and thank you for letting me know. That sounds like a hassle. Let me just pull up your order information. I see you received the VeloBand about five days ago, is that correct?
That sounds right. It feels like it's been a very long five days.

Okay, I appreciate your patience. Let me just check the return policy for that item... One moment. (pause) Alright, I've got it. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor is eligible for a full refund if returned within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So I can still return it? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Not at all. Since you're well within that 90-day window, I can process this return for you right now and email you a pre-paid shipping label. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed. Does that work for you?
Yes, that is perfect! Thank you so much, Isaac. You've really helped me out today.
You are very welcome. I'm sending that email to you now. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
